scope: Manually installed mod payloads in the game directory, corroborated by downloaded archive contents.
pathBase: Game installation directory; all installed paths below are relative to this directory.
notes: Twenty-two mod folders (including the strings-only modPTOptimization) and seven DLC folders are installed, plus native DX12 files for PT Optimization and The Living Continent: twenty-two manual mods in total. ReShade 6.8.0 (add-on build) is installed as a requirement of The Living Continent.
The October 6 update adds VAXIS's ULTRA Plus Blood Physics standard 1.2 with a full 29-file SHA-256 comparison; the earlier inventory was not rechecked in full.
The October 7 update removes Complete Animations Redux; its record moves to removedMods.
The October 7 update replaces Dynamic Appearances Project 2.1.1 with 3.0b Remastered, verified against all 12 archive files.
Dynamic Appearances Project has a mods.settings priority of 98 so it overrides Brothers In Arms (renumbered on October 15 to 95, with Brothers In Arms at 96).

The October 10 update records the October 8 game patch (executable 5.0.0.1048522) and four updated mods: Brothers In Arms 4.0.4, Sharedutils 4.1, Light Rewrite 0.19.1, and VAXIS's Blood Physics 1.4. Each was verified by a full SHA-256 comparison of every archive file. PT Optimization stays on 2.0; its 2.1 BETA is not installed.
Archive release labels and embedded descriptor versions are recorded separately because several disagree.
Selected-file SHA-256 comparisons cover .json, .ws, .xml, .ini and .dll archive entries present at the corresponding installed paths. They do not establish that every bundled asset was compared.

The evening October 11 update adds Griffin Armour (On The Path) Final and SGA T5 for On The Path 1.5, each with a full SHA-256 comparison of every archive file (4 and 6 files). The three Griffin mods have mods.settings priorities 41, 42 and 43; a stale modSlimT5forOTP entry was removed.

The night October 11 update adds The Living Continent 1.4, Deaths Reworked 2.70, and Blood And Steel 3.02, each with a full SHA-256 comparison of every installed archive file (39, 6, and 24 files; The Living Continent's readme is not installed). None of the three has a mods.settings entry.

The October 15 update adds Gwent Redux (Remastered 5.X Port) release 20 BiA edition, Gwent Redux Animated Gwent Cards release 4, and ModjiggleRR MED release 1, each verified by a full SHA-256 comparison of every installed archive file. Animated Gwent Cards was given mods.settings Priority=97 so it wins over Gwent Redux (Priority=99).

The October 15 update also records Light Rewrite 0.23.0, VAXIS's Blood Physics 1.5, The Living Continent 1.5, and PT Optimization 2.1 FINAL (Nexus release 7), each verified by a full SHA-256 comparison with no leftover files. PT Optimization 2.1 BETA had been installed on October 11 without being recorded.

A later October 15 update adds Map Remastered 2.4.1, verified against all 8 installed archive files, and records Restored High Quality Weather Icons and Moon Phases 1 under removedMods: it was installed and removed the same day because Map Remastered replaces the same minimap file.
Another October 15 update adds New Hairstyles and Beards For Geralt 4.0 (Priority=94, above Brothers In Arms for the Skellige barber scenes), verified against all 25 archive files.

A closing October 15 update adds The Elder Bush (Ciri Pube, Priority=8) and Humans of the Continent B3. Females of the Continent - Bushy Option (Priority=99, moved from 20), both texture-only and verified against their archives.

The last October 15 update replaces modShouldBeNude with the Nudes Collection Ultimate Edition 4.2.1.F (Priority=98, verified against all 4 archive files) and records modShouldBeNude and All Nudes Bushy under removedMods. At the launch that day, PT Optimization 2.1 and The Living Continent 1.5 loaded without errors.

A final October 15 update records modShouldBeNude (reinstalled from an earlier installation; the Should Be Nude file of the Nudes Collection, Nexus 5436) and renumbers mods.settings: Dynamic Appearances Project 95, Brothers In Arms 96, Animated Gwent Cards 97, modShouldBeNude 98, Gwent Redux 99.

The October 17 update adds Better Torches Next-Gen 5.1.0 (Remastered main file) and No Indignant NPCs 2.4 (Remastered main file), each verified against every file of its Nexus archive manifest (6 and 1 files). Neither has a mods.settings entry or shares files with another installed mod. With them, twenty-four mod folders are installed: twenty-four manual mods in total.

A later October 17 update and an October 18 update record three worker-thread crashes in Novigrad. PT Optimization's 'CPU: fast bone reads' option was turned off but ruled out by the third crash; the cause is open. No files changed.
A Proper Send-off was compared across all 14 archive files. A Witcher Can Hide Another was checked against its two preserved original scripts and installed descriptor.
Stale mods.settings entries are not treated as proof of installation.
This inventory verifies installed files and archive provenance evidence, not enablement or functional compatibility.
